data.name: Lalsingh
data.gender_notes: Lalsingh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Lal: God, Singh: Lion. The name Lalsingh signifies one who is a servant of God, and as a lion represents courage and strength, this name is a powerful symbol of devotion and bravery. The name Lalsingh carries the meaning “God's servant” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Lalsingh usually hope their child will grow to embody god's servant and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Lalsingh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's servant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lalsingh total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
